text: Reliability of LLM judges on numeric and table-grounded claims
path_note: Non-empirical: a literature-and-analysis paper with no experiments of its own. VERA's own domain (the judge path and the numeric audit), so Chris can judge the quality of the synthesis himself.
good_question: One specific question about when LLM-as-judge evaluators are reliable or unreliable on claims about numbers or tables, answerable by reading and synthesising the published evaluation studies.
